entities.summary: David Ojabo is a Nigerian-Scottish professional American football linebacker for the Miami Dolphins of the National Football League (NFL). He was an All-American college football player for the Michigan Wolverines, and was selected by the Ravens in the second round of the 2022 NFL draft.
